units.source_text: 入庙不久，我就马上发现，严厉的舍监被征入伍，寺庙里只剩下老者和少年了。

en.t: Not long after I entered the temple, I quickly realized that the strict dormitory supervisor had been drafted, and only old men and boys were left there.

units.source_text: 来这儿以后，我诸事如释重负。

en.t: After coming here, I felt relieved of every burden.

units.source_text: 这里的人都是我的同类，不会像俗家的中学同学因为我是和尚的儿子而另眼相待……

en.t: The people here were all my own kind, and unlike my middle school classmates in the secular world, they would not treat me differently because I was the son of a monk...

units.source_text: 所不同的，只是我口吃，比大家丑陋些而已。

en.t: The only difference was that I stuttered and was a little uglier than the others.
